// diagnostic

E0417

`priv(package)` on a field; a field is public or `priv` to its type's module (D-VIS-MODULE1)

What

`priv(package)` on a field; a field is public or `priv` to its type's module (D-VIS-MODULE1)

Why

Package privacy belongs to modules; a field hides only behind its own type's module

Fix

Write `priv` instead of `priv(package)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0417: tests/ui/vis_priv_package_field.stderr.

Error [E0417]: A field takes plain `priv`, not `priv(package)`
  --> tests/ui/vis_priv_package_field.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     priv(package) value: String
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `priv` field is usable only by its type's module; package privacy belongs to modules
 Fix: Write `priv`
